aka.zh: 锡林浩特—海安公路（2013 年以前）

tagline.en: A north–south road of about 4,200 km from the Inner Mongolian grasslands over the Taihang mountains to the ferry harbour on the Qiongzhou Strait
tagline.zh: 一条约 4200 公里的南北纵线，从内蒙古草原越过太行山，直抵琼州海峡边的渡口

start.en: Ulanhot, Hinggan League, Inner Mongolia; the drawn line begins just north-west of the city
start.zh: 内蒙古自治区兴安盟乌兰浩特市；所绘线段起于城区西北

end.en: Hai'an port, Hai'an town, Xuwen county, Zhanjiang, Guangdong, on the north shore of the Qiongzhou Strait
end.zh: 广东省湛江市徐闻县海安镇海安港，琼州海峡北岸

en: G207 is one of the north–south national highways. Under the 2013 national highway plan it runs from Ulanhot in eastern Inner Mongolia to Hai'an in Xuwen county, Guangdong, through eight provincial-level regions: Inner Mongolia, Hebei, Shanxi, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Guangxi and Guangdong. Chinese Wikipedia gives its length as 4,197.688 km. Its control points are Ulanhot, Huolin Gol, West Ujimqin Banner, Xilinhot and Taibus Banner on the grasslands; Zhangbei, Wanquan, Laiyuan and Fuping in Hebei; Yangquan, Xiyang, Heshun, Zuoquan, Licheng, Lucheng, Changzhi, Huguan and Lingchuan along the Taihang in Shanxi; Jiaozuo, Gongyi, Ruzhou, Nanzhao, Zhenping and Dengzhou in Henan; Xiangyang, Jingmen, Jingzhou and Gong'an in Hubei; Changde, Lianyuan, Shaoyang, Dong'an, Yongzhou, Dao county and Jianghua in Hunan; Hezhou, Wuzhou and Cenxi in Guangxi; and Xinyi, Gaozhou, Huazhou, Suixi, Leizhou and Xuwen in Guangdong.

Its southern end, Hai'an, is the southernmost town of the Chinese mainland. For more than sixty years the ferry harbour there was where mainland traffic for Hainan went on board. The atlas draws the route as a single piece, from just north-west of Ulanhot to Hai'an port.
zh: G207 是普通国道的北南纵线之一。按 2013 年《国家公路网规划》，它自内蒙古东部的乌兰浩特至广东徐闻县海安，途经内蒙古、河北、山西、河南、湖北、湖南、广西、广东八个省级行政区。中文维基百科给出的全长为 4197.688 公里。主要控制点：草原上的乌兰浩特、霍林郭勒、西乌珠穆沁旗、锡林浩特、太仆寺旗；河北的张北、万全、涞源、阜平；山西沿太行山的阳泉、昔阳、和顺、左权、黎城、潞城、长治、壶关、陵川；河南的焦作、巩义、汝州、南召、镇平、邓州；湖北的襄阳、荆门、荆州、公安；湖南的常德、涟源、邵阳、东安、永州、道县、江华；广西的贺州、梧州、岑溪；广东的信宜、高州、化州、遂溪、雷州、徐闻。
南端的海安是中国大陆最南端的城镇。六十多年里，大陆前往海南的车辆就在这里的港口登船过海。本图集把整条路线绘为一段，自乌兰浩特城区西北至海安港。

en: The road is being rebuilt piece by piece. In the Taihang mountains, the 12.083 km section from the Changzhi–Jincheng boundary to Lingchuan opened on 8 September 2024: 7.164 km of four-lane class-I road on a 20 m formation and 4.919 km of class-II road on 12 m, designed for 60 km/h, bypassing Houhe village and a chemical works on two new large bridges. It was the first trunk-road project in Shanxi built under a design-and-build (EPC) contract, and the builders had to deal with landslides on the way. The 53.2 km beyond it, from Lingchuan to the Henan boundary, is planned as a four-lane class-I road, according to a reply by the Jincheng transport bureau published in December 2022.

In Hunan, the Xinshao county bypass, approved in 2021, is 7.77 km of class-I road for 80 km/h, with 1,504 m of bridges in four structures, including the new Shawan bridge across the Zi River. In Inner Mongolia the new northern stretch from Houchagan, outside Ulanhot, to Alide'er is 84.326 km of class-II road for 60 km/h, planned for 2014–2016. At Xilinhot a 5.7 km class-I link for 100 km/h, begun in July 2023, takes G207 round the city and closes a 63.4 km outer ring; the construction season there lasts little more than seven months a year.
At the southern end, the 56.9 km from Longmen reservoir in Leizhou to Hai'an port was resurfaced in 2015; the kilometre posts at the port read K3669+240.
zh: 这条路正一段一段地改造。太行山中，长治晋城界至陵川段 12.083 公里于 2024 年 9 月 8 日通车：其中一级公路 7.164 公里，路基宽 20 米，双向四车道；二级公路 4.919 公里，路基宽 12 米；设计时速 60 公里，新建两座大桥绕开后河村和一处化工厂。它是山西首个采用 EPC 模式建设的国省干线公路项目，施工中要克服滑坡地质灾害。据晋城市交通运输局 2022 年 12 月公布的答复，其南的陵川至晋豫省界段 53.2 公里拟按双向四车道一级公路建设。

湖南境内，2021 年批复的新邵县绕城公路全长约 7.77 公里，按设计时速 80 公里的一级公路建设，新建大桥 4 座共 1504 米，其中包括跨资江的沙湾大桥。内蒙古境内，新增的北段自乌兰浩特后查干村至阿力得尔，全长 84.326 公里，按设计时速 60 公里的二级公路建设，建设年限为 2014—2016 年。锡林浩特的水库至豁子梁段 5.7 公里，按设计时速 100 公里的一级公路建设，2023 年 7 月开工，让 G207 绕城而过，并打通 63.4 公里的城市外环；当地每年施工期只有 7 个多月。
南端，雷州龙门水库至海安港 56.9 公里于 2015 年完成路面改造；港口处的终点桩号为 K3669+240。

en: The national trunk network issued on 30 November 1981 had 28 north–south routes; in the national numbering they carry numbers in the 200s. Before 2013, G207 began at Xilinhot: the Xilinhot–Hai'an road ran by Taibus into Hebei, through Zhangjiakou, Laiyuan and Fuping, across the Taihang by Yangquan, Changzhi and Jincheng, over the Yellow River and on by Dengfeng, Ruzhou and Dengzhou, through Xiangyang, Jingmen and Jingzhou, across the Yangtze into Hunan, and on to the north shore of the Qiongzhou Strait at Hai'an. Older references do not agree on its length: one gives 3,566 km, a cycling-route compilation 3,738 km.

The 2013 plan extended the road north-east from Xilinhot across the grasslands by West Ujimqin and Huolin Gol to Ulanhot; further south, its control points run by Lingchuan, Jiaozuo and Gongyi rather than Jincheng and Dengfeng. The renaming reached the signs later: in September 2019 Changzhi announced that G207 in its area had been renamed from the Xilinhot–Hai'an line to the Ulanhot–Hai'an line. The 2022 national highway plan keeps the same termini.

The southern terminus has changed its use. Hai'an port served ferries to Hainan for more than sixty years; on 26 September 2020 the new Xuwen port opened, with a direct crossing of 12 nautical miles to Haikou's Xinhai port instead of a zigzag of about 24, and Hai'an port became an emergency standby base.
zh: 1981 年 11 月 30 日发布的国家干线公路网有南北纵线 28 条，国道编号中纵线为 2 字头。2013 年以前，G207 起于锡林浩特：锡林浩特—海安公路经太仆寺旗入河北，经张家口、涞源、阜平，过阳泉、长治、晋城翻越太行山，跨黄河后经登封、汝州、邓州，过襄樊、荆门、荆州，跨长江入湖南，最后抵达琼州海峡北岸的海安。早期资料对其长度说法不一：一种为 3566 公里，一份骑行路线汇编为 3738 公里。
2013 年规划把这条路从锡林浩特向东北延伸，穿过草原经西乌珠穆沁旗、霍林郭勒至乌兰浩特；再往南，规划控制点改经陵川、焦作、巩义，不再列晋城、登封。路牌的更换来得更晚：2019 年 9 月，长治市公布，境内 G207 由“锡林浩特—海安线”更名为“乌兰浩特—海安线”。2022 年版《国家公路网规划》保留了相同的起讫点。
南端终点的功能也变了。海安港服务了六十多年的琼州海峡渡运；2020 年 9 月 26 日，新建的徐闻港开港，至海口新海港的航程由走“Z”字形的约 24 海里缩短为直线 12 海里，海安港此后定位为应急保障基地。

en: No cost has been published for the whole road, which is rebuilt by each province section by section. Published section figures include 606.27 million yuan for the 12 km Changzhi–Jincheng boundary to Lingchuan section in Shanxi, 774.19 million estimated for the 7.77 km Xinshao bypass in Hunan, 472 million for the 84 km Houchagan–Alide'er section and 230 million for the 5.7 km Xilinhot link in Inner Mongolia, and 900 million for the class-I Shaoyang–Tangdukou road in Hunan, begun in September 2011.

The Shanxi project shows how the money is put together. Of its 606.27 million yuan, 158.67 million came from the central vehicle purchase tax and 223.8 million each was to come from Jincheng city and Lingchuan county. The central money arrived in full; by the time of the city transport bureau's reply published in December 2022, Jincheng had paid 32.9229 million (14.7 per cent of its share) and Lingchuan 28.25 million (12.6 per cent), and the shortfall was given as one reason for delay.
zh: 全线没有公布过总造价；这条路由沿线各省分段改建。已公布的分段数字包括：山西长治晋城界至陵川段（12 公里）概算总投资 6.0627 亿元；湖南新邵县绕城公路（7.77 公里）估算总投资 7.7419 亿元；内蒙古后查干至阿力得尔段（84 公里）总投资约 4.72 亿元，锡林浩特水库至豁子梁段（5.7 公里）总投资 2.3 亿元；湖南邵阳市至塘渡口一级公路投资 9 亿元，2011 年 9 月动工。
山西这一项目可以看出资金是怎样凑起来的。6.0627 亿元中，中央车购税补助 1.5867 亿元，晋城市和陵川县财政各应自筹 2.238 亿元。中央资金已全部到位；据 2022 年 12 月公布的晋城市交通运输局答复，晋城市配套资金仅到位 3292.29 万元（占应到位资金的 14.7%），陵川县仅到位 2825 万元（12.6%），资金问题被列为工程滞后的原因之一。

en: Traffic for Hainan now crosses from Xuwen port, a little over an hour by ro-ro ferry to Haikou's Xinhai port. On the grasslands at the northern end, roadworks are confined to the warmer months.
zh: 前往海南的车辆如今从徐闻港登船，乘客滚船至海口新海港只需一个多小时。北端草原上，道路施工只能集中在较暖的月份进行。

why.en: No route-wide figure exists. G207 is built and rebuilt by eight provinces section by section; the published section costs are listed below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价。G207 由沿线八个省区分段修建、改建；已公布的分段造价分列于下。

value.en: Section by section: central vehicle-purchase-tax subsidies plus city and county money. For Changzhi–Jincheng boundary to Lingchuan, 158.67 million yuan central and 223.8 million each from Jincheng and Lingchuan; for the Xinshao bypass, national and provincial subsidies with the rest raised by Xinshao county. No route-wide statement exists.
value.zh: 分段筹资：中央车购税补助加市县资金。长治晋城界至陵川段中央车购税 1.5867 亿元，晋城市和陵川县各 2.238 亿元；新邵县绕城公路除国省补助外由新邵县筹措。未见全线出资说明。

figures.source: Jincheng Municipal Transport Bureau, 关于市政协八届一次会议第335号提案的答复, December 2022; Hunan Development and Reform Commission, 湘发改基础〔2021〕80号, February 2021

value.en: 4,197.688 km as given in Chinese Wikipedia's route box (4,197 km in its text). Before 2013, from Xilinhot, given as 3,566 km in one reference work and 3,738 km in a cycling compilation; neither is checked against the Ministry of Transport.
value.zh: 中文维基百科信息框给出 4197.688 公里（正文为 4197 公里）。2013 年以前自锡林浩特起算，一种工具书记为 3566 公里，一份骑行汇编记为 3738 公里，均未与交通运输部数据核对。

timeline.en: The national trunk network, with 28 north–south routes, is issued on 30 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 30 日，含南北纵线 28 条的国家干线公路网发布。

timeline.en: Work starts in September on the class-I Shaoyang–Tangdukou road in Hunan.
timeline.zh: 9 月，湖南邵阳市至塘渡口一级公路动工。

timeline.en: The national highway plan moves the northern end from Xilinhot to Ulanhot.
timeline.zh: 《国家公路网规划》将北端起点由锡林浩特改为乌兰浩特。

timeline.en: Resurfacing of the 56.9 km from Longmen reservoir to Hai'an port begins on 6 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 6 日，龙门水库至海安港 56.9 公里路面改造工程开工。

timeline.en: The Longmen–Hai'an resurfacing passes acceptance on 6 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 6 日，龙门水库至海安港段路面改造工程通过交工验收。

timeline.en: Changzhi announces in September that G207 in its area is renamed the Ulanhot–Hai'an line.
timeline.zh: 9 月，长治市公布境内 G207 更名为“乌兰浩特—海安线”。

timeline.en: Xuwen port opens on 26 September; Hai'an port becomes an emergency standby base.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，徐闻港开港，海安港转为应急保障基地。

timeline.en: The new national highway plan keeps G207 as Ulanhot–Hai'an.
timeline.zh: 新版《国家公路网规划》保留 G207 乌兰浩特—海安走向。

timeline.en: Work begins in July on the Xilinhot reservoir–Huoziliang link.
timeline.zh: 7 月，锡林浩特水库至豁子梁段开工。

timeline.en: The Changzhi–Jincheng boundary to Lingchuan section opens on 8 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 8 日，长治晋城界至陵川段通车。
